headline: Nvidia beat-and-raised. The pre-print tape is done.
lede: Wednesday’s print is in: NVDA did US$96.2b and guided Q3 to US$108b ±2%, above the ~US$104b street. Data centre US$89.0b. Vera Rubin in full production. Memory shortages still cap how fast they can ship — that is the MU/SNDK/DRAM line, not a scare. Marvell then printed Thursday (US$2.74b, Q3 US$3.15b ±5%) on the Google custom-silicon deal. Hugging Face talks (~US$13b) are product/ecosystem, not the quarter. Crypto sleeve bounced with bitcoin; MSTR’s US$2b raise did not sell coins. Tesla’s China door-handle recall is software/labels, not P&L. Everything else is noise.

items.title: Nvidia Q2 FY27: US$96.2b, Q3 US$108b ±2%
items.what: Beat street ~US$92b / US$2.08. Data centre US$89.0b (+117% y/y). GAAP EPS US$2.46, GM 75.0%. Q3 revenue outlook US$108.0b ±2% vs ~US$104b consensus. FY28 revenue ~+70%. No China data-centre compute in the outlook. Vera Rubin in full production. AWS: 2 million extra GPUs across 2027–28.
items.impact: The week’s event for this book is now a beat-and-raise, not a binary print. NVDA, TSM, SEMI and the call book catch the bid if the tape holds the guide. Do not chase the first green; adds only on a confirmed dip. A fade that treats US$108b as ‘in the price’ is a gift, not a thesis change.

items.title: Nvidia: memory shortages still throttle supply
items.what: On the call Nvidia said memory-component shortages will keep limiting how fast it can expand. Q2 already priced servers >15% into 2027 on HBM/DRAM. CXMT–Apple chatter last week sold MU/SNDK; the print argues tightness, not dual-source.
items.impact: Fundamental support under SMSF MU, SNDK and DRAM. The CXMT tape was the dip; the call is the confirmation. Still not a chase — memory is the most extended sleeve. Hold the lots. Add only if the book has room after a real washout.

items.title: Marvell Q2: US$2.74b, Q3 US$3.15b ±5%, Google custom
items.what: Thursday AMC: revenue US$2.739b vs ~US$2.71b and prior US$2.70b ±5% guide. Data centre ~US$2.2b (79% of sales). Q3 guide US$3.15b ±5%. Google custom-AI deal (up to US$120b over seven years, US$12.2b warrant) is the multi-year story. Shares dipped AH on the print.
items.impact: Real for MRVL and a share-of-wallet worry for AVGO, not a cancelled cycle. GOOGL is the customer. AH dip is the first look — do not add size until the Q3 guide is digested. Keep AVGO small into 2 Sep.

items.title: Hugging Face talks ~US$13b
items.what: The Information: Nvidia agreed to buy Hugging Face for US$12.9b; Business Insider says talks are live and could still fall apart. Ecosystem/inference, not Q3 revenue.
items.impact: Supports the software/agentic story around NVDA. Too small vs the US$96b quarter to re-rate the book on its own. Treat as optionality until there is a signed 8-K.

items.title: Bitcoin bounce; Strategy raised US$2b without selling coins
items.what: MSTR sold ~18m shares for ~US$2b, lifted USD reserve, did not sell bitcoin. Thursday MSTR ~US$138 (+11%) with BSOL ~+13% on the solana/bitcoin bid. BTC sleeve on this desk is EBTC + IBIT + MSTR.
items.impact: Hedge working. Not a signal to rotate the core AI book into crypto. Leave the BSOL 1515 lot. No add to MSTR calls on the bounce.

items.title: Tesla China door-handle recall still the legal item
items.what: 2.98m vehicles, labels + OTA from 25 Sep. Industry-wide China rule, not a unique Tesla defect. Nevada robotaxi cap 10 → 5,000 is longer-dated. In-house AI-chip talent leak from last week still sits under the compute thesis.
items.impact: Recall is not a material P&L hit. TSLA remains the largest satellite line. Do not add. Robotaxi is 2027+ optionality, not a reason to size up tonight.

risks.title: Guide already in the price
risks.text: US$108b can sell off if the tape wanted US$112b. NVDA + TSLA + MU are still the three largest names. A fade is not a thesis break; a China-compute surprise or a GM squeeze would be.

risks.title: Memory is extended
risks.text: Nvidia tightness is the fundamental. Valuations on MU/SNDK are not. One more CXMT-style headline and SMSF memory gives back a week.

risks.title: AVGO into 2 Sep
risks.text: Marvell–Google is share of wallet. Anthropic financing / CDS still sits under Broadcom. Keep it small through that print.

risks.title: Tesla is still satellite
risks.text: Largest line, not a core compute name. Recall + chip-talent leak. No heroics on robotaxi headlines.

rewards.title: Beat-and-raise is the core bid
rewards.text: NVDA/TSM/SEMI and the NVDA calls if the guide holds. Adds only on a confirmed dip, not the first green after the print.

rewards.title: Memory tightness confirmed on the call
rewards.text: HBM/DRAM as the bottleneck is what we wanted Nvidia to say. Hold MU/SNDK/DRAM. Bounce setup after any washout, not a chase.

rewards.title: Marvell–Google is multi-year
rewards.text: US$120b custom plus a US$3.15b Q3 guide. AH dip is the first look. Small, not a rotate-out-of-NVDA.

rewards.title: Crypto sleeve did the job
rewards.text: EBTC/IBIT/MSTR/BSOL bid while the print digested. Hedge, not a new core.

stance: Print is in. Hold the core. No forced action. Adds only on a confirmed dip in NVDA/TSM. Leave BSOL and TSLA. Watch MU/SNDK and Marvell’s Q3 guide.
